map.基于连作年限与病原菌年增长率，估算土壤病原菌积累程度与连作障碍风险等级: From continuous-cropping years and annual pathogen growth rate, estimate soil pathogen buildup and the obstacle-risk level

map.当前病原菌密度 = 初始密度 × (1 + 年增长率%)^连作年限；连作障碍指数: Current pathogen density = initial density x (1 + annual rate%)^years; obstacle index = current density / threshold density x 100
map.病原菌随连作年限按复利式累积：初始密度乘 (1 + 年增长率) 的年限次幂。以阈: Pathogens accumulate compound-style with cropping years: initial density times (1 + annual rate) to the year power. The obstacle index is benchmarked to threshold density (current / threshold x 100) with accumulation multiple (current / initial). Index <30 safe, 30~60 warning, >60 severe, suggesting routine monitoring, rotation/soil disinfection, or rotation with bio-fumigation or resistant varieties.
map.💡 公式：当前密度 = 初始密度 × (1 + 年增长率)^年限；障碍指数 =: 💡 Formula: current density = initial density x (1 + annual rate)^years; obstacle index = current density / threshold density x 100; <30 safe, 30-60 warning, >60 severe
map.本工具采用指数增长模型，适用于病原菌在连作条件下逐年积累的近似估算: This tool uses an exponential-growth model, suited to approximate year-by-year pathogen buildup under continuous cropping
map.阈值密度为该病原菌引起显著减产的临界值，不同作物、病原菌差异较大，请参考当地植保: Threshold density is the critical value causing significant yield loss; it varies by crop and pathogen, so consult local plant-protection data
map.实际连作障碍还受土壤理化性状、根系分泌物、微生物群落等多因素影响: Actual obstacles are also shaped by soil physics/chemistry, root exudates, and microbial communities
map.本工具纯前端运行，数据不上传，结果仅供风险评估参考: Pure front-end, no upload; results are for risk assessment only

map.综合连作年数、前茬寄主一致性、土传病害史评分。: Score by cropping years, previous-host consistency, and soil-borne disease history.
map.指数高提示自毒与病原基数累积。: A high index signals autotoxicity and pathogen-base buildup.
map.用于土壤处理决策（消毒/轮作/嫁接）。: Used for soil-treatment decisions (disinfection / rotation / grafting).
map.连作 5 年、年年同科、枯萎病史阳性，三项加权得指数 75/100。建议下茬嫁接: 5 years continuous, same family yearly, positive wilt history; weighted score 75/100. Suggestion: graft next crop onto black-seed pumpkin rootstock (wilt-resistant) and solar-disinfect 20 days in summer, or fallow with onion/garlic to suppress nematodes.
map.病原菌积累为什么难发现？: Why is pathogen buildup hard to detect?
map.多存在于土壤与残体，地表看不出，发病才显症且已晚。靠连作年限与前茬记录预判比靠肉: Mostly in soil and residues, invisible from the surface; symptoms appear only when diseased and too late. Predicting by cropping years and previous-crop records is more reliable than the naked eye.
map.盛夏灌透水、覆透明膜密闭 2~4 周，利用积温杀灭表层病原与杂草种子。成本低的物: In midsummer, saturate with water, cover with clear film and seal 2~4 weeks, using accumulated heat to kill surface pathogens and weed seeds. A low-cost physical method but dependent on hot season.
